title: Workout Has Target
prompt: A workout alert needs to know whether an exact rep count appears. Write a function that returns true when the target value is in the array.

explanation.beginner:
Example: workoutHasTarget([5,10,12,0], 10) produces true. The result must follow this precise rule: A workout alert needs to know whether an exact rep count appears. Write a function that returns true when the target value is in the array. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “rejects missing targets”: input [[5,10,12,0],9999] produces false. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
